title: Reha Enquiry Agency - Mr. Rudolf Rein

page_data.en:
TYH
FM. 2
G. 90M-1-◆

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
S.1. Special branch 18646/9335
REPORT
Date July 13 19 39
Subject "RENA" Enquiry Agency: advertisement appearing in the Shanghai
Jewish Chronicle dated July 9, 1939.
Made by D.P.S. Roberts Forwarded by C. Gauson O. I

Enquiries show that the attached
advertisement appearing in the Shanghai Jewish
Chronicle dated July 9, 1939 was inserted by
one Rudolf Rein.
Mr. Rudolf REIN, is a German Jew, aged
30, born in Berlin on April 15, 1909 who arrived
in Shanghai on December 20, 1938 in the s.s.
"Conte Biancamano." He is in possession of
passport No. II/2582/38 issued in Berlin and
holds "I.C." Relief Committee Registration
Certificate No. 205. It is reported that
REIN is part owner of the premises at 140/8
Columbia Road. (a boarding house)

D J Roberts
D.P.S.

FILE
dbk

Copy to S.C.
D.C. (Special Branch)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号............
S.1. 特别股 18646/9335
报告
日期：1939年7月13日
事由：“RENA”问询社：刊登于1939年7月9日《上海犹太纪事报》的广告。
呈报人：D.P.S. Roberts 转呈人：C. Gauson O. I

经查，附上的刊登于1939年7月9日《上海犹太纪事报》的广告系由一名叫鲁道夫·莱因（Rudolf Rein）的人刊登。
鲁道夫·莱因先生，德籍犹太人，30岁，1909年4月15日出生于柏林，于1938年12月20日乘“比安卡马诺伯爵号”（s.s. "Conte Biancamano"）轮抵达上海。他持有在柏林签发的第II/2582/38号护照，并持有“国际委员会”救济委员会注册证第205号。据报，莱因是哥伦比亚路140/8号（一家寄宿公寓）的部分业主。

D J Roberts
副警务总监

存档
dbk

抄送：高级警司
警司（特别股）
